test_title: PYST 35: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Direction: In the following sentence, an idiom is highlighted. Select the alternative which best describes its use in the sentence.

The scheme says nothing new; it doesn't ***__break new ground__.***

options.text: To look into your own matter
To do something that you should not be doing

solution:
Here the correct answer is **To do something innovative.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct meaning of the idiom **"break new ground"** in the given sentence is** 4) To do something innovative.**
 
• The idiom **"break new ground"** means **to do something innovative or to pioneer a new approach or idea that has not been done before**.
 
• In the given sentence, the scheme is described as not breaking new ground, which means it does not offer anything new or innovative.
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• The company's innovative research on sustainable energy is expected to **break new ground** in the field of renewable energy.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.**
